definitions.explanation: A grammatical term referring to words that name people, things, places, or concepts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{形容詞|けいようし}→形容詞：10419_keiyoushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名詞|めいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修飾|しゅうしょく}→修飾：00460_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名詞|めいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単数形|たんすうけい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{複数形|ふくすうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Japanese nouns do not distinguish between singular and plural.

notes:
{名詞|めいし} is the grammatical term for "noun" — a word that names a person, thing, place, or concept. Essential vocabulary for studying Japanese grammar.

JAPANESE PARTS OF SPEECH ({品詞|ひんし}):
- {名詞|めいし}: noun
- ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧: verb
- ⟦{形容詞|けいようし}→形容詞：10419_keiyoushi⟧: adjective (i-adjective)
- {形容動詞|けいようどうし}: na-adjective
- ⟦{副詞|ふくし}→副詞：00441_fukushi⟧: adverb
- ⟦{助詞|じょし}→助詞：03351_joshi⟧: particle
- ⟦{助動詞|じょどうし}→助動詞：12373_jodoushi⟧: auxiliary verb
- ⟦{接続詞|せつぞくし}→接続詞：16564_setsuzokushi⟧: conjunction

WATCH OUT:
⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧ (business card) has the same reading but different kanji.

USAGE:
In Japanese grammar, {名詞|めいし} does not inflect — there is no plural form or grammatical gender, unlike many European languages.
